results.expectation: Prescribes documenting a contribution model that specifies who can propose, who reviews, and who approves
results.evidence: Proposer: Any designer or developer can propose... Reviewers: At least one designer and one developer must review... Approver: A single system owner...

results.expectation: Assigns each component a clear owner
results.evidence: Assign a Clear Owner to Each Component ... Every component needs an owner

results.expectation: Enumerates the requirements of a self-governing contribution process: proposal format, design rationale, review checklist, and merge criteria
results.evidence: A. Proposal Format... B. Design Rationale (Non-Negotiable)... C. Review Checklist... D. Merge Criteria

results.expectation: Attributes compliance problems to ambiguous documentation and says to resolve them at the component definition stage, not after the fact
results.evidence: Compliance problems don't happen in production—they happen when teams don't have clear documentation to reference... The existing Button documentation didn't cover their use case

results.expectation: Recommends regular audits comparing the design system to what is actually in production
results.evidence: Regular Audits: System vs. Production ... Audit your codebase — search for component usage.
